text: A4 (verifies R4) (manual): The message for a note with no text reads naturally.

comments.text: Blocking: 'Reads naturally' is an opinion that cannot fail. The message is also unreachable under R1. If kept, fix the exact wording and make the criterion an automated check on that text.

Blocking: R4 now has a reachable trigger, but 'reads naturally' is still an opinion and cannot fail. Kept manual on purpose. The criterion is about how the wording reads to a person, so a reviewer confirms it. The trigger is reachable under R4, which covers a refused save for missing text.
